header: Four partners, and what each of them signs off
lead: Aubruck has been a partnership since 2016. If a job goes wrong, one of these four is the person who rings you — we have never let that be a shared responsibility.

people.title: Marlene Ostermann
people.text: Joined in 1998 as a surveying technician and took the office over from Gerhard Tulln in 2016. Signs every fee proposal above forty thousand euros.

people.title: Andrea Brandstätter
people.text: Runs the cadastral side and the control network. Twenty-one years of boundary work in the district, which is why the land registry usually rings her first.

people.title: Tobias Reindl
people.text: Road and drainage design, and the office's site supervision. Came from a civil-engineering contractor in 2009 and still thinks like a site manager.

image.alternative: A woman in her late twenties

people.title: Katja Sunder
people.text: Contracts, invoicing, insurance and the apprentice scheme. If a question is not technical, it ends up on her desk and is usually answered the same day.
